style.vernacular: Coral atoll settlement on a narrow strip of sand and palm: single-storey elevated timber-frame houses clad in asbestos-cement sheet with metal roofs (Australian government housing), small airport and administration buildings in pale render or fibre-cement with corrugated roofs, plus Cocos Malay village houses on Home Island in painted timber with bright tin roofs. Coconut palms, white coral sand and lagoon beaches everywhere.
style.ornament: Houses raised on stilts for ventilation and flood protection, with raked end walls, front porches, louvre shutters and shaded verandahs; Home Island mosque with a green-and-gold minaret; hand-painted signs and simple palm-thatch palapa shade structures.
